title: Interactive VPC connection map and preflight checks for private onboarding
creator: Maya Chen
description: Design and deliver a set of onboarding visuals and interactive UI assets that show a customer their VPC connection topology, run stepwise preflight/network checks, and illustrate the upgrade/install flow for private and air-gapped deployments. Deliverables include an interactive connection map prototype, static screenshot variants for docs, annotated installer states, and a handoff checklist for engineering and docs.
acceptance_criteria: Interactive Figma prototype that demonstrates live status overlays (green/yellow/red) and hoverable path traces for up to three network hops
A static screenshot library (desktop and mobile widths) covering first-time install, preflight failures with remediation callouts, and upgrade preview modal
Annotated spec (copy + token color/spacing) and exported SVG/PNG assets with 2x rasterization for docs and in-product help
Accessibility review notes included (contrast ratios, keyboard interactions for the interactive map, aria labels for check results)
Handoff checklist completed and linked PR created for engineering integration work
screenshots_inventory: Upgrade: diff modal - compatible/incompatible changes highlighted (1366x768)
design_notes: Interactive map should visualize logical connections (control plane, data plane, telemetry) with separate color lanes
Preflight checks are grouped: Networking, DNS, Ports, Certificates, KMS reachability. Each check has a short remediation CTA that opens contextual help
When a check fails, reveal a focused overlay with the minimal command users can run locally and links to the diagnostics page
Upgrade modal shows side-by-side current vs target with a risk score and a rollback CTA; include copy variants for low- and high-risk upgrades
Provide two visual density variants: compact (dashboard) and detailed (docs walkthrough)
engineering_feedback: ENG-42108: runtime team requests that map events emit minimal websocket topics to limit noise; changed prototype to aggregate health updates every 4s
ENG-42567: install telemetry team asked for a namespaced telemetry key to identify preflight origin; added telemetry_key in handoff notes
ENG-42791: security flagged KMS check wording — must avoid implying key material is transferred; copy updated to clarify reachability only
review_comments: PM review (Aisha Patel): prefer clearer prioritization of checks with a suggested quick-fix order
Security review (R. Gupta): requested additional microcopy for audit logging in private installs
Accessibility review (Taylor Nguyen): map hover states need keyboard focus and announceable labels for screen readers
Design critique (internal): reduce skeuomorphic cable art; provide schematic lines instead for faster scanning
handoff_checklist: Export Figma components as tokens and place in design tokens file
Provide SVGs with stroke-to-path outlined version for older rendering targets
Add sample JSON payload for preflight API response in the PR description
Create docs Snippets folder with 2x PNGs and copy variants
Include unit-test cases for three preflight failure modes in the engineering ticket
risks_and_tradeoffs: Interactive map requires lightweight client-side aggregation; too-frequent updates impact mobile — trade to 4s aggregation
Detailed remediation steps increase support surface; we limit inline remediation to one-click CTAs linking to docs for complex fixes
Air-gapped variants require additional screenshots and copy; deferred full localization for non-English until rollout-2
next_steps: Resolve accessibility comments and update prototype (owner: Liam O'Connor)
Push Figma exports and asset bundle to the shared drive and update PR with links
Coordinate with ENG-43210 to implement the websocket health topic and ingest schema
Schedule design review with compliance for KMS wording sign-off by 2026-03-18
